domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: User-only impact framing
canonical_definition: The system is evaluated only from the buyer's or operator's perspective while affected non-users and rights are ignored.

conditions: All systems affecting people; formal impact assessment depends on role, jurisdiction and consequence.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit User-only impact framing: The system is evaluated only from the buyer's or operator's perspective while affected non-users and rights are ignored.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show omitted non-users, missing vulnerable-group analysis, or rights considered only after complaint?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of User-only impact framing, or does it remain unknown?

conditions: Refer verified user-only impact framing to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 5.1 (PDF p. 32), MAP 5.2 (PDF p. 33), MEASURE 4.2 (PDF p. 36)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on identifying impacts, engaging relevant actors and evaluating trustworthiness in context. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where the impact analysis covers only buyers or operators despite identifiable affected non-users. The mechanism can have an operational effect where actual downstream decision paths omit a materially affected or vulnerable group from mitigation and monitoring.
potential_consequences: People affected indirectly may bear significant harm without a corresponding mitigation.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether the impact analysis covers only buyers or operators despite identifiable affected non-users. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether actual downstream decision paths omit a materially affected or vulnerable group from mitigation and monitoring. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review compare workflow and output consumers with consulted and evaluated groups, residual impacts and follow-up decisions. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether the impact analysis covers only buyers or operators despite identifiable affected non-users. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether actual downstream decision paths omit a materially affected or vulnerable group from mitigation and monitoring. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide compare workflow and output consumers with consulted and evaluated groups, residual impacts and follow-up decisions. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Compare workflow and output consumers with consulted and evaluated groups, residual impacts and follow-up decisions.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether the impact analysis covers only buyers or operators despite identifiable affected non-users, and separately check whether actual downstream decision paths omit a materially affected or vulnerable group from mitigation and monitoring. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use compare workflow and output consumers with consulted and evaluated groups, residual impacts and follow-up decisions. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A proportionate assessment may use representative consultation where exclusions and limitations are justified and reviewable.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in E1 alone cannot establish AP-E1 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows user-only impact framing
Implementation or operating evidence shows user-only impact framing
Presence or tested absence of user-only impact framing is unresolved within scope
